description: Small public-safe synthetic fixture for methodology-aligned deterministic fixture checks. This fixture uses exact and structured expected-output checks only; it does not use provider calls, model inference, semantic judging, human grading, H100/GPU/CUDA/server/remote execution, production data, private data, or external dataset data.

items.input: Synthetic support ticket asks for password reset after an expired link.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic fixture label must exactly match the expected public-safe label.

items.input: Synthetic invoice stub includes three line totals: 12, 8, and 5.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic numeric total must exactly match the expected integer.

items.input: Synthetic request asks for a billing FAQ answer with refund context.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic ordered tag list must exactly match.

items.input: Synthetic routing summary for a deterministic FAQ answer.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic summary object must exactly match the expected object.

items.input: Synthetic normalized ticket object should expose the required reviewer fields.
items.acceptance_criteria: The observed public-safe object must include every required key.

items.input: Synthetic incident summary should expose stable field types.
items.acceptance_criteria: The observed public-safe object must include the declared fields with the expected simple JSON types.

items.input: Synthetic document stub contains a purchase order number and delivery window.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic document type label must exactly match.

items.input: Synthetic retry policy allows two local retries before fallback.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic retry budget must exactly match the expected integer.

items.input: Synthetic offline workflow routes through validation, cache lookup, and deterministic answer stages.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic ordered workflow stage list must exactly match.

items.input: Synthetic repeated request matches a local cache key.
items.acceptance_criteria: The deterministic cache result object must exactly match the expected object.

items.input: Synthetic report row should include stable summary fields.
items.acceptance_criteria: The observed public-safe object must include every required key for a report row.

items.input: Synthetic structured result should expose deterministic route metadata.
items.acceptance_criteria: The observed public-safe object must include the declared deterministic result fields with expected simple JSON types.

items.input: Synthetic response-quality candidate would require semantic or human judgment in a separately approved goal.
items.skip_reason: Semantic or human judgment is outside deterministic fixture-check scope.
items.acceptance_criteria: Skipped items must be counted separately and must not be treated as checked deterministic results.

items.input: Synthetic ambiguous prompt lacks a public-safe expected output and would require a provider in a separately approved workflow.
items.skip_reason: Provider-needed work is unsupported in this deterministic fixture-check slice.
items.acceptance_criteria: Unsupported provider-needed cases remain skipped and are not counted as deterministic checks.
